basic_profile.bio: I'm a 35-year-old software developer based in Nairobi, Kenya. I have a deep passion for technology and enjoy tinkering with audio setups in my spare time. I work remotely for a tech company, which sometimes requires me to juggle multiple audio streams during my workday. When I'm not working, you can find me exploring local music scenes or hiking in the beautiful Kenyan landscapes. I typically log on to Reddit during my breaks and in the evenings. I'm currently single and enjoy the flexibility and freedom that comes with it.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science from the University of Nairobi and have been working in the tech industry for over a decade. My expertise lies in software development and system configurations, which I've primarily honed through hands-on experience and online courses. I'm always eager to learn new technologies and enjoy contributing to tech forums.
